title: Employee Performance Write-Up
description: A formal write-up template documenting performance issues.
intro: Use this template to document performance or conduct concerns.
whenToUse: When an employee needs a formal warning or documentation in performance files.
template:
Date: [Date]
Employee: [Name]
Issue: [Details]
Action Required: [Improvement Steps]
Follow-up Date: [Date]
example:
Date: May 1, 2026
Employee: Jordan Smith
Issue: Repeated missed deadlines
Action Required: Submit weekly status and meet deadlines
Follow-up Date: May 29, 2026

faqs.question: Is HR review required?
faqs.answer: Often yes; coordinate with HR before issuing formal write-ups.

title: PTO Request Email
description: Template to request paid time off from a manager.
intro: A concise email for requesting PTO.
whenToUse: Requesting planned vacation, personal days, or medical leave.
template:
Subject: PTO Request - [Dates]

Hi [Manager Name],

I’d like to request PTO from [Start Date] to [End Date]. I will ensure [Coverage Plan].

Thanks,
[Your Name]
example:
Subject: PTO Request - June 10–14

Hi Maria,

I’d like to request PTO June 10–14. I will hand off current tasks to Priya and leave instructions.

Thanks,
Sam

faqs.question: How much notice?
faqs.answer: As much as possible — two weeks is common for planned time off.

title: Attendance Write-Up
description: Documenting attendance concerns in a formal write-up.
intro: Use to document repeated attendance or punctuality issues.
whenToUse: When attendance policies are violated repeatedly.
template:
Employee: [Name]
Issue: Tardiness on [Dates]
Action: Improvement plan and follow-up on [Date]
example:
Employee: Chris
Issue: Tardy on May 3, 5, 7
Action: Submit weekly schedule and meet with manager on May 21

title: Urgent PTO Request
description: Request template for urgent unplanned time off.
intro: A short message requesting urgent leave.
template:
Hi [Manager],

I need urgent leave starting [Date] due to [Reason]. I will update you as soon as possible with details.

Thanks,
[Name]
example:
Hi Alex,

I need urgent leave starting May 19 due to a family emergency. I will share more details soon.

Thanks,
Taylor
